messages.subject: Initialization Period
parts:
I recently deployed an app on ShinyApps.io and the user interface appears right away once I select the link. However, it takes about 5 minutes before I can start running the app. After this 5 minute period, everything works fine. Is this some kind of initialization period? 

Here is a link to the app:

https://bioenergetics4.shinyapps.io/bioenergetics4/

If you modify the "Final Day" widget and press "Run" at the bottom, you should be able to see the problem I am experiencing. 

Thanks for your help,

David
